title: Enable Franka workbench HDF5 upload
goal: Safely enable the upload capability for the data_uplload worktree after confirming a valid writable upload destination.
doneWhen: The active configuration enables uploads without allowing writes to an unintended local fallback directory.
The configured upload destination has been verified reachable and writable using the application's sink probe.
decisions: Do not set upload.enabled=true while /mnt/nas is absent: the local transport probe and uploader create the configured path, which could silently write to the host filesystem instead of NAS storage.

verification.summary: Upload code and active configuration were inspected; the configured local NAS destination is not mounted or present.
checks: config.yaml: upload.enabled is false; destination is /mnt/nas/forge/franka/raw with local transport
limitations: NAS mount or an approved SSH upload endpoint has not been provided.

blocker: No verified writable upload sink is available at the configured destination.
nextAction: Provide or mount the intended NAS destination, or provide SSH host/key/path details; then enable upload and run the application sink probe.
